title: Niyama: Breaking the Silos of LLM Inference Serving
summary_zh: ASPLOS 2026 program 中以 QoServe 為題展示的 QoS-driven LLM serving system。Niyama 將 interactive/batch silo 改成 fine-grained QoS co-scheduling，結合 dynamic chunking、EDF/SRPF hybrid prioritization 與 eager relegation。相較 Sarathi-Silo，在滿足 QoS 下 serving capacity 最高提升 32%，A100 GPU 需求降低 13–32%，極端過載下 SLO violation 降低一個數量級。
summary_en: QoS-driven LLM serving system listed in the ASPLOS 2026 program under the QoServe title. Niyama replaces interactive/batch silos with fine-grained QoS co-scheduling, combining dynamic chunking, EDF/SRPF hybrid prioritization, and eager relegation. Against Sarathi-Silo, it raises serving capacity by up to 32% while meeting QoS, reduces A100 GPU demand by 13–32%, and cuts SLO violations by an order of magnitude under extreme overload.
